origin.usage: rollmedian(x, k, fill = if (na.pad) NA, na.pad = FALSE, align = c("center", "left", "right"), ...)

arguments.name: k
arguments.text: Window width in observations. It is truncated toward zero.

arguments.name: fill
arguments.text: Three fill values for the left side, the interior gaps, and the right side. A shorter vector is recycled and a longer one keeps the first three. NULL drops those positions. "extend" repeats an end and linearly interpolates an interior gap.

arguments.name: align
arguments.text: Where the window sits on its result time: center, left, or right. A unique prefix is enough. NULL selects center.
Further arguments. A missing value in rollmean, rollsum, or rollmedian is handled by rollapply, and those arguments are passed through.

origin.details: An odd width is the middle order statistic of each full window. An even width is raised to the next odd width, as runmed does, and that shorter result is recycled onto the alignment of the original width. A missing value, or a width longer than the series, uses rollapply. An empty series is returned unchanged. rollmedianr is the right-aligned wrapper.
origin.value: An object of the same kind as x with the rolling median. A plain vector returns the values.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Series, vector, or matrix. A Zoo keeps its index.
